# NonEquilibriumPhase

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A phase of matter that is not in thermodynamic equilibrium, characterized by time-dependent order parameters and memory effects. Underlies the persistent, history-dependent behavior needed for adaptive and learning-capable neuromorphic systems.
